test_suite_name: V3 Unpopulated Planet Acquisition Restart Verification
description: Reauthenticate after the serving game process restarts and compare planet info with persisted PostgreSQL ownership and assets.

tests.name: Reconnect acquiring player after server restart
Reconnect former owner after server restart
Reconnected owner's planet response matches persisted ownership and empty population
Former owner cannot read the newly owned unlanded planet
Restart preserved population, assignments, stock, treasury, and exactly one capture event

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id} AND p.owner_type='player' AND p.population=0 AND p.population_type='UNPOPULATED' AND p.colonists_unassigned+p.colonists_ore+p.colonists_org+p.colonists_eq+p.colonists_weapons=0 AND p.fighters=0 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=456 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977740%')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE p.planet_id=977740;
